## Flagship System: APEX CONNECT Voice AI Platform
APEX CONNECT is a production multi-tenant voice agent SaaS system. It handles inbound/outbound voice calls and WhatsApp messages through a real-time speech-to-speech AI pipeline.

### Platform
* Cloud-native and autoscaling, with rolling zero-downtime releases.
* Multi-tenant by design: every tenant's data, sessions and limits are isolated.
* Real-time voice: streaming speech-to-text, a streaming LLM and low-latency text-to-speech, with barge-in.
* Perceived end-to-end latency: roughly 0.6–1.5 seconds per turn.

## APEX Connect pricing (SaaS)
APEX Connect is sold as a subscription, per tenant (workspace). Prices in INR, GST as applicable.
- Bring your own SIP: ₹4,999 per tenant per month — the full platform (AI voice agents, AI receptionist, appointment system, WhatsApp Business API integration, Hindi & English, dashboard, recordings, transcripts, analytics). Connect Twilio, Telnyx, Vapi or an Indian SIP provider; the carrier bills its minutes directly.
- Starter: ₹14,999 per month — 2,000 AI calls; platform, numbers and minutes included.
- Growth: ₹29,999 per month — 4,500 AI calls; platform, numbers and minutes included.
- Scale: ₹49,999 per month — 10,000 AI calls; platform, numbers and minutes included.
- Business, Enterprise, White-label: custom pricing.
- REST API & webhooks: usage-based, metered per request. MCP server: flat monthly subscription per workspace.

## AIM — AI operating layer for your machines (free)
AIM gives your AI a machine — and gives you the controls. It runs on your Windows PC and connects your phone, desktop and voice to the machine where the work happens: see it, control it, delegate to it. Local AI models or cloud providers (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, OpenRouter, Groq). Encrypted end to end over a direct WebRTC link; no account needed.
- Windows installer: https://aimstudio.co.in/remoteai/AIM-Setup.exe
- Android app (Remote AI): https://aimstudio.co.in/remoteai/AIM.apk
- Chrome extension: https://aimstudio.co.in/remoteai/AIM-extension.zip
- Product page: https://aimstudio.co.in/remoteai

## Technical Capabilities (Demonstrated)
* **Kubernetes**: Rolling updates, horizontal autoscaling, health probes, TLS termination.
* **Caching & queues**: Priority queues, rate limiting, idempotency and response caching.
* **SaaS Multitenancy**: Isolated async semaphores per tenant, secure context window boundaries, and isolated data partitions.
* **CI/CD**: Automated build, test and rolling deploy on every release.

## B2B Engagement Scope
Remote B2B contracting directly with AIM (registered by the Government of India, Udyam MSME), outside IR35. Hire one dedicated engineer or a team sized to the scope.
* **AI Platform Build**: 4–12 weeks.
* **Architecture Review & Rescue**: 1–2 weeks.
* **Production Incident Response**: Days to 2 weeks.
* **Fractional Platform Engineering**: 3–6 month retainer.

## Chief Technology Officer: Ankit Panicker
AI Systems Engineer · Software Architect · CTO. Based in Madhya Pradesh, India. Works across the full software lifecycle — architecture, backend, frontend, APIs, AI orchestration, voice AI, automation, distributed workers, queues, databases, cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, observability, reliability, security boundaries, deployment and operations.
Guiding principle: design for the failure path first and the happy path second.
Education: MBA (Finance), Sinhgad Business School; B.Com, Seva Sadan Mahavidyalaya. Earlier automation and process engineering work associated with Navalsingh Sahakari Shakkar Karkhana Maryadit. Certifications: IBM Cloud Essentials, Google Cloud Digital Leader, Cisco Networking Academy foundational credentials.
Company: AIM — AI Infrastructure & Machines (AIM Studio).
Deepest areas: Python/FastAPI, Redis primitives, queues/workers, reliability engineering. Kubernetes, Terraform and model internals: effective, not claimed as deepest. AI role: systems integrator and orchestrator, not a model trainer.

## Systems
- APEX Connect: telephony, STT, LLM orchestration, TTS, campaigns, tenant-aware routing, messaging, background workers, Redis queues, PostgreSQL, WebSockets. At-least-once delivery, idempotency guards, Redis-synchronised distributed circuit breaking, per-tenant call-capacity control, persistent queue/WAL state, chaos/stress/E2E testing. Live healthcare deployment: 15,000+ outbound calls dialled, 6,800+ answered (~45%). Audit notes: persistence complexity, some fail-open behaviour, large surface area, credential-looking files flagged for due diligence.
- APEX HMS: offline-first multi-tenant hospital platform (OPD/IPD, beds, pharmacy, lab, notifications, billing, integrations, RBAC, multi-hospital). WAL + replay, single-authority job supervision, tamper-evident audit chains, durable outboxes. Under active construction; latest audit: 30 suites — 28 passing, 2 failing; 94 tests pending/skipped.
- Shortz: local-first AI video pipeline — script → TTS → voice alignment → subtitles → FFmpeg — with FastAPI, Redis, XTTS, Whisper, Prometheus, Grafana; per-stage telemetry, soak testing and failure injection. Systems-oriented application engineering, not a mature production service; uneven test depth.
- Apex Core: deterministic automation and remote system control — explicit commands, controlled execution, observable state, auditable results.

## Production deployments
Apple Hospital (AI voice outbound patient calling) · BIMTS College (multi-tenant institutional platform) · Café Ciel, London (hospitality platform for a UK client).
